anchors.historical_data_caveat: Three independent personas (options-positioning, base-rates, macro-peers) flagged that this list's chronological order does not reconcile with what they found in independent research (e.g. the May-2026 print looks like a ~-9% to -15% reaction, not the list's -26.49%). Carried forward as given per the no-fabrication rule; distribution stats (mean/median/max) used rather than any single most-recent datum.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Roughly ±12-15%, centred slightly below the 12.9% anchor in magnitude but with a fat left tail; spot is fractionally above the $84.41 mean analyst target after a +46% run, so a beat is required just to hold flat.
key_drivers: Consensus revenue/FY27 guide is the literal midpoint of management's own guidance, so an in-line print is a de facto miss; the whole August run-up is already priced.
The metric that matters is CRPO growth and cloud/committed mix, not EPS; needs to hold >=20% to reset the AI-search narrative.
23-Jun restructuring (~7% headcount, $22-25M charges) is not embedded in the guide — an EPS/margin beat is the likelier positive surprise, but a lower-quality catalyst for an AI-re-rated stock.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: Six straight quarters of revenue-guide beats plus un-modelled restructuring savings give room for a clean beat-and-raise; if CRPO accelerates past 20% a stock at 4.5x NTM sales can gap +15%.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No clean 60/90-day revision breadth series; no consensus CRPO figure; Phase-0 -26.49% most-recent datum conflicts with press reports of a ~9-11% May-2026 decline, used as given.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±13-16%; 12.9% anchor fair-to-slightly-cheap vs 14.23% mean-abs / 26.49% max-abs history. IV Rank 67.5 / IV Percentile 88, steep backwardation but not extreme.
key_drivers: Crowded long, chased: OI put/call 0.26, unusual call buying mid-Aug, spot ~25-33% above 50/200-DMA, PTs hiked into the event.
Same-day divergence: session put/call volume 1.39 on a day the stock is +6.83% — flow buying downside into the ramp.
Squeeze fuel thin, not absent: short interest 6.98% of float, 2.7 days to cover (13 days stale).
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: 4:1 call-heavy OI plus 6.98% short float means dealers chase into $90/$95 strikes on a guidance raise; +18.2% 30-day EPS revision may reflect real channel checks.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No strike-level OI/GEX, skew, or borrow-fee data; short interest 13 days stale; flags the same historical-move ordering discrepancy as other personas.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±10-14%; 12.9% anchor close to fair vs 14.2% mean-abs history. The vol is roughly right; the entry point is what's mispriced — spot at the consensus target after three discrete rally legs.
key_drivers: Sentiment escalated in three event-anchored steps in 30 days (OpenAI tie-up, AQR stake disclosure, today's AI-tape beta) leaving price at the average analyst target.

Sell-side capitulation wave (Cantor, BofA, Truist, Barclays, Oppenheimer, Jefferies, JPM all raised targets) into a name that closed lower on 5 of its last 8 prints, including a ~26% fall on a revenue beat in May.
Verifiable corporate catalysts (OpenAI, Deductive AI, Gartner MQ leader) argue this is not a pump, but insiders show 14 sales / 0 buys.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The enterprise-software tape is in a genuine upside cycle this week (NVDA, CRM, OKTA, CRWD all beat and rallied); the peer read-through may be real demand, and a consumption inflection plus a raise could squeeze +15%.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Live retail sentiment/message-volume metrics were login-gated; the 88/100 'extremely bullish' read is ~2 weeks stale. Lowest-confidence tier of the panel.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: Base-rate expected absolute move ~13-15% (8-quarter mean abs 14.2%). The 12.9% anchor is slightly cheap vs. realised (exceeded in 5 of 8 prints); the fresh 16-17.5% monthly straddle read is rich (exceeded in only 1 of 8).
key_drivers: Directional tilt negative: 3 up / 5 down over 8 sourced quarters (37.5% up), thin sample.
'Good print, stock falls anyway' has happened twice: Feb-2026 was a double beat and the stock still fell ~12-15%.
Today's setup (spot +47% above the pre-print base, +6.8% intraday into the event) resembles the prior down-gap cohort more than the up-gap cohort.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The base rate rests on 8 observations and the negative tilt is driven by two outsized down-gaps; conservative CFO guidance plus a 6.8%-short float means a beat-and-raise could replicate the +37% / +14.8% / +12.3% up-gaps in the sample.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: Flags the Phase-0 historical-move list as likely mis-ordered relative to independent sourcing; could not build a matched sector/size/run-up/IV cohort.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ~11-15%, at or slightly above the 12.9% anchor and in line with the 14.2% mean-abs history. Magnitude roughly fair; direction is where the edge is thin.
key_drivers: Peer split favours AI-accelerators over pre-run mid-teens growers: Datadog beat-and-raised and fell 15-21%; Dynatrace beat-and-raised off a low bar and rose 10.3%. ESTC's own guide (~13-15% growth) is closer to the Datadog template.
Backdrop is risk-on for AI infra (NVDA, CrowdStrike both beat big overnight) and ESTC is already +6.83% on someone else's news into its own print — a pre-consumed catalyst.

IGV is -17% since June / -11% YTD on 'SaaS vs AI-agent cannibalisation' fears even as ESTC has decoupled +55% upward — carrying AI-winner pricing inside a sector that stress-tests that label every print.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: If Elastic delivers the CrowdStrike template — a discrete, quantified AI-consumption acceleration plus an FY27 raise — in a tape just blessed by NVDA's framing, the ~6.7%-short float amplifies the move up; neither MongoDB nor Snowflake has reported yet so ESTC would set sector tone.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No IGV/WCLD flow data or confirmed index-inclusion event; also flags the historical-move ordering discrepancy.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ±13-16%; 12.9% anchor slightly cheap vs. 14.2% mean-abs / 14.7% median-abs history. Direction is emphatically not priced in: spot sits at/above the mean sell-side target after a +28.8% one-month run.
panel_verdicts.consensus_view_as_i_read_it: Bullish momentum: AI-search/agentic-security winner (OpenAI collaboration, Deductive AI acquisition closed 2026-08-24, third straight Gartner Observability MQ Leader), sell-side stampeding targets higher into the print.
panel_verdicts.strongest_reversal_case: This is the same trap that sprung three months ago: on 2026-05-27 Elastic beat (rev $450.7M vs ~$446M, non-GAAP EPS $0.61 vs $0.56) and the stock still fell 26.49% because FY27 guidance implied only ~14.6% growth. The stock has since re-rated ~+58% off its late-June close on narrative alone, and a Buy-rated bull (Rosenblatt) publicly expects only an in-line-to-marginal beat this quarter.
panel_verdicts.what_would_break_my_reversal_case: Elastic Cloud reaccelerating above ~28-30% y/y on genuine AI/vector-search consumption, paired with an FY27 revenue raise to ~$2.03B+ and no margin walk-down from the Deductive AI deal.
key_drivers: Guide-not-print risk: FY27 already cut to ~14.6% growth in May; a merely in-line guide after a +28.8% month is enough to break the stock.
Positioning: spot above the mean target after a wave of catch-up PT raises published the same week.
Beat magnitude has compressed to ~1% (Q4) while consensus sits exactly on the guidance midpoint.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: The numerical bar is genuinely low (consensus is literally the guidance midpoint) and ESTC is not a stretched multiple (~26x forward EPS, ~5.1x TTM sales); a normal beat plus an FX-flattered raise plus the AI narrative could squeeze +15%.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No live option skew/put-call or current borrow rate; no single ESTC-specific news item found explaining today's +6.83%, pointing to pre-print momentum/PT-chasing rather than fundamental news.

panel_verdicts.expected_move_view: ~14% absolute, slightly more than the 12.9% anchor and roughly in line with the 14.2%/14.7% mean/median history. Distribution is left-fat: stock +84% off the April low, +6.8% intraday into an AMC print, sitting at/above the raised sell-side target on a Hold.
panel_verdicts.insider_signal: None found — the only cluster is non-discretionary sell-to-cover (annual RSU vest); the informative absence is no buying, including through the drawdown to $46.
panel_verdicts.communication_signal: Defensive reframing plus a cost-funded margin story: CPO resignation and a 7% RIF landed within four weeks of the FY27 guide, with no guidance reaffirmation in the 8-K; CEO language ('a sign of confidence, not a retreat') reads as pre-empting the opposite interpretation.
key_drivers: Insider track is empty in both directions across July and August; Elastic insiders rarely buy, so this is weak evidence, but there is zero conviction behind the 84% rally.
FY27 guidance (May 28) already embeds deceleration (+14.6% vs +17%); within four weeks the CPO resigned and a 7% RIF was booked, which reads as margin funded by headcount, not demand.

Alt-data is thin: unusual call volume on Aug 14 is momentum positioning; short interest ~6.81% of shares out is squeeze fuel but not squeeze-grade; job postings suggest the RIF was a reallocation, not a demand collapse.
panel_verdicts.top_risk_to_my_call: CRPO is the one metric with no forensic edge; if it holds or accelerates above 20% and the RIF lets them raise FY27 EPS, the short base and Deductive AI/agentic-observability narrative could squeeze this violently.
panel_verdicts.evidence_note: No August 2026 Form 4/144 filings found (read as genuine absence); no borrow-fee or dark-pool data; Deductive AI deal closed 3 days before the print — a bullish counterweight noted but not weighted, since companies rarely stack good-news cadence into a bad quarter.

synthesis.move_band_note: unsigned magnitude band, right-skewed; the implied move is roughly one standard deviation, not a cap
synthesis.early_prediction: Unusually aligned panel (disparity 8.7, all 7 scores between -15 and -28) leans mildly bearish, but consensus -20.7 falls short of the -25 Lean Down threshold, so Neutral / No Edge is the honest call, not a suppressed lean. The main driver is that spot ($84.66) already sits at/above the $83.67-84.41 sell-side mean target after a +55% three-month run and a +6.8% pre-print pop, so a beat is largely priced; the main caveat is a well-documented company-specific pattern of beating and still falling on guidance optics, flagged independently by several personas.
synthesis.red_team_survival_note: Survives comfortably. The red-team case (score -28, reversal_risk 72) is specific and sourced: ESTC beat cleanly on 2026-05-27 and still fell because FY27 guidance implied only ~14.6% growth, corroborated independently by two other personas (fundamental, base-rates) from separate angles without citing the red team.
